what: Seconds from the request to the first piece of the plan being complete, and to the whole plan, for fresh sets, calling api/director.ts from a desktop on home broadband with the instructions cached. claude-opus-5-5, fast mode, low effort, structured output.
limit: The headset's own share is not in this number: its speech recogniser, the Quest's network, and drawing the pieces.

runs.said: a night chase, a red car racing past a burning truck, two actors running at camera, and a dragon on a rooftop
runs.title: Night Chase
runs.says: Red car races past a burning truck as two actors run in, dragon on the roof; low wide 18mm shot.

runs.said: a medieval castle gate with two guards and a horse, low angle
runs.title: Castle Gate
runs.says: A stone gatehouse flanked by two guards with a horse before it, shot from a low angle on a 24mm.

runs.said: a spaceship landing in a desert canyon, an astronaut walking toward it at sunset
runs.title: Canyon landing
runs.says: Saucer settling between canyon rocks in dust, astronaut walking to it; low wide shot from behind him.

runs.said: two people arguing across a cafe table
runs.title: Cafe argument
runs.says: Two actors face off across a small cafe table, framed as a 50mm two-shot at eye level from the side.

runs.said: a crowd running from a giant robot down a city street
runs.title: Robot Street Panic
runs.says: A giant robot looms over a street as a crowd flees towards a low 18mm camera looking up past them.

runs.said: a car and a red dragon
runs.title: Dragon and car
runs.says: A red dragon looms over a parked car, framed low and wide from the front so the beast towers.

runs.said: a wizard casting a spell on a bridge in the fog
runs.title: Wizard on Foggy Bridge
